question: Change the DB.Querier method signature from Querier(mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error) to Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error) by adding a context parameter. DB is the main TSDB entry point used by Thanos sidecar and Mimir ingester for local time-series storage. All callers must pass a context.

primary_changes.description: Change the Queryable interface method from 'Querier(mint, maxt int64) (Querier, error)' to 'Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (Querier, error)'. This is the core interface that all implementations depend on.

Change QueryableFunc type from 'func(mint, maxt int64) (Querier, error)' to 'func(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (Querier, error)' and update its Querier method at line 265 to accept and pass ctx.
Update MockQueryable.Querier method signature to accept ctx context.Context as first parameter.

Change DB.Querier from 'func (db *DB) Querier(mint, maxt int64) (_ storage.Querier, err error)' to 'func (db *DB) Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (_ storage.Querier, err error)'. This is the main TSDB entry point method. The context is not yet used in the body but is needed for interface compliance and future use.

prometheus_internal_callers.description: Update fanout.Querier method: change signature to 'func (f *fanout) Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (Querier, error)' and pass ctx to f.primary.Querier(ctx, mint, maxt) and storage.Querier(ctx, mint, maxt) calls at lines 75 and 82.
Update sampleAndChunkQueryableClient.Querier method: change signature to accept ctx context.Context as first parameter.

Update three call sites from 'api.Queryable.Querier(timestamp.FromTime(start), timestamp.FromTime(end))' to 'api.Queryable.Querier(ctx, timestamp.FromTime(start), timestamp.FromTime(end))'. The ctx variable is already available from r.Context() in each handler.
Update FakeQueryable.Querier (line 60) and TSDBNotReadyQueryable.Querier (line 488) mock implementations to accept ctx context.Context as first parameter.

thanos.description: Update queryable.Querier: change from 'func (q *queryable) Querier(mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)' to 'func (q *queryable) Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)'. Implements storage.Queryable interface for Thanos distributed querying.

Update promClientsQueryable.Querier: change from 'func (q *promClientsQueryable) Querier(mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)' to 'func (q *promClientsQueryable) Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)'. Used for rule evaluation querying.

mimir.description: Update userTSDB.Querier: change from 'func (u *userTSDB) Querier(mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)' to 'func (u *userTSDB) Querier(ctx context.Context, mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)'. Must also pass ctx to u.db.Querier(ctx, mint, maxt) at line 199.

Update three call sites from 'db.Querier(mint, maxt)' / 'db.Querier(startTimestampMs, endTimestampMs)' to pass a context. These are in ingester methods that handle LabelValues (line 2084), LabelNames (line 2141), and MetricsForLabelMatchers/Series (line 2194). Context is available from the gRPC request context in each method.
